title: The Top 10 Songs Played at Atlanta Strip Clubs in January 2026
summary: The new year brought some newcomers into the mix, like Bally Baby.
contentText:
The holiday season flew by and the calendar flipped to a new year, but it was status quo for strip clubs across the country, with a clean slate entering a fresh campaign in January.

Billboard  launched the  inaugural strip club chart  in August and will continue to track the top tracks played monthly at four prominent Atlanta strip clubs.

For those new around here,  Billboard  joined forces with DJ Monitor, a service that installs music-recognition technology for venues and festivals, along with a contribution from the Coalition DJs, to collect data from different Atlanta strip clubs.

Belly Gang Kushington starts 2026 how he closed out 2025 on the strip club chart, holding down the top slot once again with the “Friend Do (Remix)” alongside ATL rapper YKNIECE. There’s a newcomer on the chart: Atlanta-based rapper Bally Baby makes his debut, while  Metro Boomin  and  Lil Baby  earn multiple entries in January’s top 10.

As far as the artists who had the most real estate on Atlanta strip club playlists for January, the top 10 goes as follows:

No. 10,  YoungBoy Never Broke Again  (149)
No. 9, Belly Gang Kushington (165)
No. 8,  Gucci Mane  (174)
No. 7,  21 Savage  (181)
No. 6,  Young Nudy  (248)
No. 5,  Jeezy  (286)
No. 4,  Metro Boomin  (344)
No. 3,  Bossman Dlow  (414)
No. 2,  Lil Baby  (513)
No. 1,  Future  (914)

U.S. club owners interested in contributing data can send an email to hiphop@billboard.com. Check out the top 10 songs going off in Atlanta strip clubs below.
